result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed. The main visual defect is a duplicated restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel; a couple of minor consistency issues were also noted.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel shows the same restaurant twice: two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards with the same image, '15–25 min' badge, and '€0.90 delivery' price appear side by side.
issues.suggestion: De-duplicate the restaurant list before rendering the carousel (e.g., filter by unique restaurant ID) so each restaurant appears only once.

issues.description: Favorite (heart) buttons appear on the large 'Popular right now' cards but are absent from the 'Fastest near you' cards, creating inconsistent interaction affordances across restaurant cards.
issues.suggestion: Apply the favorite button consistently to all restaurant cards, or intentionally document/design the difference between card types.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card (pizza, −20% badge) shows no restaurant name, rating, or delivery info visible before the viewport cutoff, and its heart icon sits on a dark circle unlike the ramen card's plain heart, making the two cards look inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Ensure card metadata layout and favorite-icon styling are consistent across all cards in the 'Popular right now' list.
